{{Quote|I am A-4P0, Jedi archivist. How may I help you?|A-4P0|<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi" />}}
'''A-4P0''' was a [[Librarian droid/Legends|librarian droid]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as an analyst in the [[Jedi Archives (Tython)|Archives]] of the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A-4P0 was stationed in the Archives during the [[Flesh Raider uprising|uprising]] of the native [[Flesh Raider]]s<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi" /> in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}} A-4P0 appears during Act I for the Jedi Knight class, placing their appearance in 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] answered the comm when the [[Hero of Tython|apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] contacted the Archives for information on the ancient machine known as the [[Vur Tepe|Forge]]. When the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] told A-4P0 of how Master Din had been captured by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Bengel Morr]] and how the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] had taken Din to the Forge, A-4P0 transmitted the young Jedi information on the location and warned the apprentice that the Temple Masters were occupied striking at other Flesh Raider camps and would not be able to aid the Padawan in [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
A-4P0 first appeared in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. His only appearance is in [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] form during the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] mission "Weapon of the Jedi" on Tython, where he gives the player the location of the Forge.<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi" />
